sentences: Random k-SAT generates Boolean clauses according to a specified distribution and asks for a satisfying assignment.
The source asks whether such assignments can be found efficiently in a density regime where their existence is known.
The question separates statistical satisfiability from algorithmic accessibility.
The surrounding overlap-gap analysis investigates whether the geometry of solutions obstructs broad algorithm families near that regime.
